bug.actual_behavior: The template calls graphics::par() unconditionally; in a non-interactive R session this opens the default PDF device and leaves an empty Rplots.pdf in the working directory.
bug.additional_notes: The same unconditional par call also exists in the optional showtext branch and should receive the same guard.
evidence: The installed template calls graphics::par(family = base_family) during automatic initialization and the resulting PDF has zero pages.
bug.expected_behavior: Sourcing the environment template should configure plot defaults without creating files or opening a graphics device.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Start a non-interactive R session in an empty working directory.
Source a 00.Environment.R generated from the bensz-rmd-rules template.
Observe that Rplots.pdf is created even though no plot was requested.
bug.summary: 00.Environment.R template opens the default PDF device during source and creates Rplots.pdf
bug.workaround: Only call graphics::par() when grDevices::dev.cur() is greater than 1; keep the selected family in options for devices opened later.
